A consistent address plan

Unit 1 · Week 12 · Lesson 4 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the addressing chapter and its learning resources. Use paper or a local editor as appropriate, with fictional data and disposable practice copies. The suggested 55-minute lesson is flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. A consistent address plan

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Explain the goal and the expected independent outcome. Allocate usable addresses without duplicates. This is ungraded textbook learning. Suggested times can be adjusted to the class. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#addressing. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

2. Retrieval and explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval, then partner comparison

The network is 192.168.40.0. Duplicate addresses on the network make delivery and ownership ambiguous. Allow silent thinking before discussion. Ask a learner to justify an answer before revealing the explanation. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#addressing. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

3. Library practice plan

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked table and teacher explanation

For this ordinary /24, do not allocate .0 or .255 to hosts. The twelve desktops need twelve distinct addresses. This is a paper plan, not a deployment instruction. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#addressing. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

4. A gateway mismatch

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and explain

The gateway is outside the client’s stated /24 local subnet. In this ordinary directly connected example, choose the intended reachable local gateway .40.1. Pause for predictions before discussing the expected result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#addressing. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

5. Allocating mobile clients

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Use distinct unused host addresses, such as .40.40 onwards. Note that operational DHCP needs configuration; a paper allocation does not configure it. Swap explaining and checking roles so both learners articulate the reasoning. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#addressing. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

6. Independent practice

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application with optional support

Accept a different coherent allocation. Count all required interfaces and document reservations. Avoid changing any school device configuration. Offer the relevant worked example if needed, then use a changed case to check independent understanding. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#addressing. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

7. A choice to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Whole-class response and justification

B. Different labels do not resolve a duplicate interface address on the same subnet. Give thinking time and collect reasons, without recording scores. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#addressing. Technical/course references: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1122 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc1918 https://senior-secondary.scsa.wa.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1090875/Year-11_12_Computer-Science_ATAR_Additional-syllabus-support-booklet-.PDF

8. Exit explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual reflection and fresh explanation

Check distinct usable host addresses, local gateway and the /24 network comparison. Use the response to select the next explanation or practice activity. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#addressing.
